name: Access gate
mechanism: A participant reaches the protocol subject to the current Terms and jurisdiction restrictions.
proves: The published conditions for who may use the Site and Protocol as of the evidence date.
doesNotProve: That every technically reachable wallet is eligible or that access is global.

name: Capital enters
mechanism: Apyx documents accepted user capital entering its protocol flow before treasury deployment.
proves: The flow described by Apyx in its product documentation.
doesNotProve: Current availability, transaction volume or independent reconciliation of deposits.

name: Treasury allocates
mechanism: The documented offchain treasury acquires preferred securities and liquid assets.
proves: The intended custody and allocation architecture.
doesNotProve: The assets held at this moment, their valuation or reserve sufficiency.

name: Cash flow crosses
mechanism: Declared cash dividends are collected offchain; Apyx says value is then moved to an onchain vault that changes apyUSD redemption value.
proves: How the published design connects issuer cash flows to protocol accounting.
doesNotProve: That a dividend will be declared, arrive on schedule or match a quoted return.

name: Token state exists
mechanism: The two published addresses resolved as initialized classic SPL Token mints with six decimals at finalized slot 438320962.
proves: Token representation and visible mint/freeze authority configuration at that slot.
doesNotProve: Reserves, legitimate supply, liquidity, bridge safety or redemption behavior.

name: Holder receives a claim
mechanism: The Terms describe protocol-generated tokens as programmatic claims against modules holding assets.
proves: How Apyx documents the holder relationship to protocol modules.
doesNotProve: Direct ownership of STRC or SATA, or a claim against a particular company or person.
